metadata.name: editor-lists-operations
metadata.description: Smoke proof for the deterministic-ops vertical slice (req IMG-P0-001): navigates to the Editor page and asserts the operation picker is populated with the deterministic operations. This exercises the full live path — UI → OpsService.ListOperations (Connect-RPC) → the internal/ops registry — so a broken discovery RPC, an unmounted ops module, or a UI that fails to render the picker all fail here. The op execution path itself (multipart run edge) is covered by api/handlers/ops/rest_test.go and the headless CLI acceptance in docs/internal/TESTING.md.

assert.failure_message: Operation picker does not list 'resize' — OpsService.ListOperations did not reach the UI (check the ops module is mounted in main.go, the OpsService handler is registered, and ui/src/api/ops.ts targets the right transport).

metadata.label: Assert the deterministic op catalog is rendered (proves discovery end-to-end)
